steps.label: No automatic scanning
steps.sub: 2.1M+ customer identities across 5 systems, by hand, is not real coverage

steps.label: No classification engine
steps.sub: a column tag in a spreadsheet never actually protects a column

steps.label: No cross-system lineage
steps.sub: one tool's own lineage view stops at its own front door

eyebrow: One governance domain, one Data Map
code:
Governance domain:  Veridian Data Governance

Data Map sources registered & scanned:
  veridian-sql-prod   (Azure SQL -- core transactions)
  Salesforce           (CRM)
  ORACLE_FIN            (Oracle Financials)
  VERIDIAN_DW           (Snowflake warehouse)
  Fabric lakehouse  ->  Power BI semantic model -> dashboard
caption: Five systems, one catalog, one place to look -- not five private spreadsheets.

eyebrow: What this decision does NOT require
code:
DOES NOT REQUIRE:
  Migrating any of the 5 source systems
  Downtime on Azure SQL, Oracle, or Salesforce
  Rebuilding the existing Power BI reports
  Manually re-tagging columns system by system

Purview connects and scans what already exists --
it does not replace it.
caption: Naming what this doesn't touch is usually what gets it approved.
